tasks.answer: No dedicated special-passenger booking-detail component is present in the catalog. The closest general component is bookings.TravelerBookingDetailScreen (export TravelerBookingDetailScreen, import "@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen"). It renders a traveler booking detail page with status transitions, evaluations and media, and requires bookId. Caveat: it is a general traveler-booking detail screen with no special-passenger/assistance-specific fields (e.g. wheelchair, SSR/assistance codes, medical or accompanying-passenger data); special-passenger semantics would have to be added or composed on top, and its actions are permission-gated and the screen needs query and router providers.
